row.notes: Binds a render-target set on the Gfx2 command context (param_1 ctx): resets bind state (Render_Gfx_ResetBindState), stores RTV count (+0x70) / flags (+0x74) and depth view (+0x138/+0x140), copies up to 8 RTV views (+0x78..+0xb0), hashes formats with MD5 (Ne_Hash_Md5Transform/Finalize) into +0x148 (render-target-set key used for PSO lookup), registers resources via Ne_HashMap_FindOrInsert_Float and calls context-impl vcall +0x60. ~20 render-pass callers. Hypothesis on exact name (OMSetRenderTargets equivalent).
